verdict.rationale: This story is about a governance or entity-management records platform that gives outside counsel law-firm-specific roles for maintaining corporate records. Claude is a general AI assistant and model platform, not a corporate records system, so the axis is a category error. Its generic team workspaces, SSO and shared-workspace features are adjacent and do not make this records-and-roles capability applicable.

support.subject: As an ops user, my outside counsel can work directly in the platform with law-firm roles — preparing documents and updating records without emailing spreadsheets
